title: G7 complete preflight accepted a missing or wrong formal experiment identity
evidence: Before repair, a valid formal G7 fixture with no experiment_id on any plan row returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true with errors=[] under require_complete_plan=True. The executable formal plan does carry experiment_id=g7_failure_localization, but the preflight did not enforce that identity.
remediation: Require every complete-plan row to carry the fixed executable experiment identity g7_failure_localization, add adversarial missing/wrong identity tests, and rerun the immutable formal plan with an independent identity scan.
